param.label: Minimum mapping quality
param.help: Only reads with at least this mapping quality are considered.

param.label: Include reads with SAM flag
param.help: Only consider reads with all of these SAM flag bits set, e.g. 64 for first-in-pair reads.

param.label: Exclude reads with SAM flag
param.help: Discard reads with any of these SAM flag bits set, e.g. 16 for reverse-strand reads.

param.label: Duplicate filter
param.help: How to identify duplicate reads. Read start and barcode are always considered. Leave empty to keep all reads.

param.label: Motif filter
param.help: Keep only reads with a given motif at the 5' end of the read and/or the 5' overhang in the genome, as 'read_motif,genome_motif', e.g. A,TA. Requires a 2bit genome. Separate multiple motif pairs with spaces.

validator.message: Motifs must contain only A, C, G, T or N, as 'read,genome' pairs separated by spaces

param.help: Required when a motif filter is set.

param.help: Keep only reads whose GC fraction lies within 'low,high', e.g. 0.1,0.9.

param.help: Minimum fraction of the read that must be aligned (excluding indels and clipping).

param.label: Filter RNA strand
param.help: Keep only RNA-seq reads originating from genes on the given strand (assumes a dUTP-based library).

param.label: Extend reads to fragment length (bp)
param.help: Extend single-end reads to this fragment length. Paired-end reads are always extended to the fragment defined by both mates. Not recommended for spliced RNA-seq reads.

param.label: Center reads on the fragment
param.help: Center reads with respect to the fragment length, giving sharper signal around enriched regions.

**About sincei**
sincei is a toolkit for the exploration of single-cell (epi)genomics data, from BAM files to count matrices, clustering and pseudo-bulk signal. For full documentation, see https://sincei.readthedocs.io
